# doxygen-awesome-css

Unmodified `doxygen-awesome.css`, `doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only.css`,
`doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only-darkmode-toggle.css`,
`doxygen-awesome-darkmode-toggle.js` and MIT license from
[jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css](https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css/tree/46483f1e5a70ffb9ecd3b82d0a1cd1b24edf13da),
release v2.5.0, commit `46483f1e5a70ffb9ecd3b82d0a1cd1b24edf13da`.

SHA-256:

- `doxygen-awesome.css`:
  `ea37516ec7a7a7780719b9d9a285fe3268a8d5411523d8b93af98d77e67cd1a1`
- `doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only.css`:
  `909d17055552149555fc87c5e0cf171a41d09a9e358c389a51b25ddfafd462af`
- `doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only-darkmode-toggle.css`:
  `c1939ca910d2282068482abc72e9edcf9835e4de153ebe8b428cbace92ed4c2c`
- `doxygen-awesome-darkmode-toggle.js`:
  `11951aeb28a182af457a354073b8c05c9bb3c39121e5704e44eabaca8d86d5ff`

Only the source browser (`make site`, `site/build.sh`) uses this theme;
`site/theme/wc1.css` restyles it and `site/header.html` adds the light/dark
switch.
